label: Diffuse cutaneous systemic sclerosis
summary: Diffuse cutaneous systemic sclerosis: autoimmunity, endothelial injury, fibroblast activation and skin fibrosis, with interstitial lung disease and renal crisis branches. Mixed-subset SSc studies retain their context; excludes limited cutaneous disease, morphea and overlap syndromes.
query: (TITLE_ABS:"diffuse cutaneous systemic sclerosis" OR TITLE_ABS:dcSSc OR TITLE_ABS:"scleroderma renal crisis") AND (TITLE_ABS:mechanism* OR TITLE_ABS:fibrosis OR TITLE_ABS:fibroblast* OR TITLE_ABS:endothelial OR TITLE_ABS:autoantibod* OR TITLE_ABS:interleukin OR TITLE_ABS:"TGF" OR TITLE_ABS:nintedanib OR TITLE_ABS:tocilizumab OR TITLE_ABS:mycophenolate OR TITLE_ABS:cyclophosphamide OR TITLE_ABS:transplantation OR TITLE_ABS:"RNA polymerase" OR TITLE_ABS:topoisomerase)
